next_legitimate_job_only.source_reviews: Exactly actual pending sources once each, with their own frozen ID/SHA/quote. Do not insert the already-reviewed original as pending or present its quote as a new source quote.
next_legitimate_job_only.case_observation_evidence_source_ids: Actual frozen pending IDs only, never add old source ID solely because it was reread.
next_legitimate_job_only.due_only_job: If no pending, source_reviews/evidence_source_ids empty. Old supplement alone cannot support supports/counterevidence. A due job cannot retain; actual worker must set a justified later management date or unset with reason. No future outcome/date precommitted here.
next_legitimate_job_only.summary_required_context: Include read_at, supplement path/SHA, original ID/native snapshot and a concise resolved/residual summary: standalone contract-change-inclusive order table; CF not prepared is not zero; existing segment narrative, unread p9 and unresolved profitability/cash conversion. This was old public information newly read, not new issuer disclosure.
next_legitimate_job_only.case_observation_rationale_required_cont: Preserve the same issue and same read_at/file/SHA/source/native SHA plus standalone vs consolidated/parent-owner scope, prior Q1 vs prior quarter, order vs sales/backlog vs profit, explicit contract-change inclusion, CF non-preparation not zero, p9 unread not non-disclosed, and remaining forecast/model/threshold adoption gaps. next_legitimate_job_only.propagation: Put this substance in both summary and case_observation.rationale, not only source_reviews.rationale or external README. Existing future prior_review projects those two fields. Result remains exactly the existing five top-level fields, no attachment field.
next_legitimate_job_only.before_any_question: Check public answers and source/period again; exclude the closed items above.
